test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) QKHC 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a4960cb39335258a5f1b4e3cbc94222b4434f0e5e857cbf3e014c9dbda440b2.png] 

Option 2) FZWR 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05177ebd5f883f0ed9444387a5c2d5e03863d9e31c6d34478790928ca7c03d3d.png] 

Option 3) WQNJ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/110394cdffecee33223d9f6d336f670cb03676103465f4cabb335d4e28b1d0a8.png] 

Option 4) KEBW 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba60647a22d786f4a149a43463064254a224e16e6b72f15d20f2b86d35979db4.png] 

Thus, out of all 'WQNJ' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
